cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, has just counted every man twenty and older who can serve in the army (Numbers 1:2-3). That's a LOT of people, friend. Now the LORD speaks to Moses and his brother Aaron (Exodus 4:14), and the big question is: where do you PUT everybody?

cards.question: The LORD tells the Israelites to camp all the way around something. What sits at the center of it all?

cards.text: Each man camps under his standard, with his family's banners, the way people hunt for their car in a parking garage muttering, "We were Section B. I KNOW we were Section B." And the Levites already have their own job: camping around the tabernacle and watching over it (Numbers 1:53).

cards.question: True or false: the LORD tells the tribes to pitch their tents right up against the Tent of Meeting.

cards.text: East side, toward the sunrise, is the camp of Judah, led by Nahshon son of Amminadab, with Issachar and Zebulun beside them. That's 186,400 men, PACKED in like a cookie box on a holiday, and when Israel moves, they set out first.

South side: the camp of Reuben, led by Elizur son of Shedeur, with Simeon and Gad beside them. That's 151,450 men setting out second, and second is FINE, friend, I spent years at the back of a drawer.
East and south are set, but before the LORD gets to the other two sides, He talks about the middle. That's the part everybody's camped around.

cards.question: When Israel is on the move, who travels with the Tent of Meeting in the middle of the camps?
True or false: when they set out, each tribe travels in the same order it camped, in its own place under its standard.

cards.text: West side: the camp of Ephraim, led by Elishama son of Ammihud, with Manasseh and Benjamin beside them. That's 108,100 men setting out third, and I have officially run out of mustache to count on.
On the north side camps Dan, led by Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai, with Asher and Naphtali beside them. That's 157,600 men setting out LAST, and hey, somebody's gotta turn off the oven on the way out.
Add up all four camps and you get 603,550 men, and every one of them has a spot for his tent. Meanwhile I can't find my own rolling pin, and I live on a planet just big enough for my bakery.

cards.question: True or false: the Levites, who travel with the Tent of Meeting, are counted in that total of 603,550.

cards.text: So the Israelites do EVERYTHING the LORD commanded Moses. They camp under their standards this way and set out the same way, each man with his clan and his family.
